Title: Power-on time
Requirement: The device shall be operational within 5 s of power application.

Title: Operating temperature
Requirement: The device shall operate from -20 C to +60 C.

Title: Emergency stop
Requirement: The device shall stop all motion within 100 ms of an emergency stop input.

Title: EMC emissions
Requirement: The device shall comply with radiated emission limits.

Title: User manual
Requirement: The device shall ship with a user manual in all EU languages.

Title: CAN interface
Requirement: The device shall provide a CAN 2.0B interface at 500 kbit/s.

Title: MTBF
Requirement: The device shall have an MTBF of at least 50000 h.

Title: Start button
Requirement: The device shall start a cycle when the start button is pressed.
